title: Research whether ANY dedicated software is purpose-built to output a CLEAN full-screen program fe...
objective: Research whether ANY dedicated software is purpose-built to output a CLEAN full-screen program feed to a physical HDMI capture card from a Windows gaming PC (an alternative to OBS Studio's fullscreen projector), and whether such software would deliver higher quality OR efficiency for livestreaming at 1080p60. Survey and evaluate: vMix (Output / External / Fullscreen Output, NDI outputs), Streamlabs Desktop, NDI Screen Capture HX + NDI Tools, XSplit Broadcaster, OBS-NDI plugin, Resolume, hardware downstream keyers, dedicated 'game view capture' utilities, and any niche 'capture card output' tools you can find. For each, state whether it specifically targets the task 'render one video source FULLSCREEN onto an HDMI output to be captured by a capture card' and whether it would BEAT OBS projector on quality or efficiency at 1080p60. Explain WHY there isn't really a dedicated specialized app for this, i.e. that the upstream task ('render a source fullscreen') is trivial and OBS projector is near-optimal because the real lossy step is downstream at the capture card itself. CONCLUDE with a clear recommendation: should the user stay on OBS projector or move to a dedicated app, and which (if any), and the reasoning. Cite source URLs with a confidence note.
